short: Atta — black-box engine: a file in, an output out
is: Atta, a host-agnostic black-box engine: it takes a file, or a file's contents, and produces an output. It knows none of Zurfur's types, and lives in this workspace as a crate only until it is split into its own library.
conventions: Never depends on another workspace crate and never names a Zurfur type — host-agnostic by construction, so it can be split out unchanged.
Its definition is deliberately minimal — a file in, an output out; grow it only as real needs appear, never ahead of them.
